name: 46069 · Sheridan, IN
findings: ZIP 46069 (Sheridan) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46069 (Sheridan) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46069 (Sheridan) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46069 (Sheridan) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
